Initial ideas:
- Football scores are counts. Use some sort of Poisson regression model
- Two models: one predicting home team scores, the other away team score
- One model combining the two above to make a final prediction.
- Clustering teams based on historical performance?
- Covariates:
  - Team strength:
    - Historical goals scored (how many goals have been scored by that team so far - issue is that we start with data from 2014)
    - Recent performance (what ranking this team had in the previous year and how many goals they scored in total)
    - Opponent strength (opponent historical goals and previous ranking and goals)
    - Home advantage 
    - Matches played and rest time (how many matches has this team played so far and when was the last match)
  - Team variations:
    - Squad turnover (which players are in this team)
    - Experience 
    - Previous season goals/League performance
    - Some sort of metric for new players
  - Individual player stats:
    - Premier League history
    - Age
    - Position
    
- For new players who have not played before, use a technique for dealing with missing data to get a "strength score" for that player.
- Assign each player a score based on FPL data, and see how that score changes over the years (is there a trend?) so then the model will predict that score for the next year. 
- Compare scores of different positions in any match and get an overall team score (defense and attack?)
- Make a model which predicts match outcomes based on these scores (Poisson?, Cubist?)



I think it would be better to have a model which looks at two rows per match, so option B. There should be these columns:
- Match id
- year
- Date 
- Team of interest
- Opponent
- Home or away (for the "Team of interest")
- PDSF = Difference in previous season goals per match
- PDSCF = Difference in previous season goals conceded per match
- PDR = Difference in previous season ranking 
- PDW = Difference in previous season wins
- PDD = Difference in previous season draws
- PDL = Difference in previous season losses
- Round = Difference between the round of the game being played during the season
- Days = Difference in number of days since last match played
- DWF = Difference in win frequency
- DLF = Difference in loss frequency
- DDF = Difference in draw frequency 
- DGSF = Difference in goals scored per match
- DGCF = Difference in goals conceded per match
- DAS = Difference in attack scores
- DDS = Difference in defense scores
- DRF = Difference in red cards per match
- DYF = Difference in yellow cards per match
- DFF = Difference in fouls per match
- DCS = Difference in corners per match
- DSTF = Difference in Shots on Target per match 
- DSF = Difference in Shots per match


DAS and DDS should be calculated like 
DAS = (goals scored per match in previous season for team of interest * k + goals scored per match in current season for team of interest* number of matches played by team of interest)/(k + number of matches played by team of interest) - (goals scored per match in previous season by opponent * k + goals scored per match in current season by opponent * number of matches played by opponent)/(k + number of matches played by opponent)
Similar for DDS with goals conceded. 
The difference calculations come from doing team of interest - opponent. This reduces the numbers of columns and is easier to perform feature engineering/selection.

Want to get rid of DRF, DYF, DFF, DCS, DSTF and DSF after feature selection since the model would not know how to predict matches without that info if it is trained on those predictors. Keep it in for analysis for now.

For the new teams, goals scored and conceded should be calculated from the median of the other teams. This is from the assumption that the level that the new teams are at are about average compared to the teams last year. I decided on making k = 2 as I want the model to quickly forget about the team's attacking and defense strength from the previous year. This is done for 2 reasons:
- The new teams do not have an accurate attack and defense score due to the unavailability of data.
- The players change within the teams, so the model quickly needs to be able to update these scores.

Having the scores calculated from the previous season avoids the restriction that the other paper had with having to get rid of the first 5 games. 

Also, averaging over the goals from the season so far means that we don't constrain ourselves with needing good predictions to get good predictions later on. As in if 5 consecutive predictions are wrong, they'll affect the next 5, affecting the next 5 and so on. Doing it this way may reduce uncertainty, although it may also reduce accuracy. 

```{r} 
keep_cols <- names(X14_15)[1:23]

match_data <- c("X14_15", "X15_16", "X16_17", "X17_18", "X18_19",
                "X19_20", "X20_21", "X21_22", "X22_23", "X23_24", "X24_25")

for (nm in match_data) {
  assign(nm, get(nm)[, keep_cols])
}
X14_15 <- X14_15[-381,]
```

Could have a dataset like 
Year 
Home Team | Away Team 
Home result | Away result 
Home Team Historical Attack Score | Away Team Historical Attack Score 
Home Historical Defense Score | Away Historical Defense Score  
Home Previous Year Ranking | Away Previous Year Ranking 
Home Current-season matches played | Away Current-season matches played
Home win frequency | Away win frequency
Home loss frequency | Away loss frequency 
Home draw frequency | Away draw frequency
Home Current-season goals scored per match | Away Current-season goals scored per match
Home Current-season goals conceded per match | Away Current-season goals conceded per match
Home frequency of red cards per match | Away frequency of red cards per match 
Home frequency of yellow cards per match | Away frequency of yellow cards per match

If a team doesnt have any info, then let the model learn from how the new teams perform every year
The historical scores column for the teams competing in 2015/16 could be calculated based on the X14_15 data. 
Then, the scores could be updated in another column. At the end of the season, so the last row for that year which represents a specific team could be combined with the score from the previous year in an equation which would put more weight on the scores from that year. Then, those scores could move onto the next year's historical scores column.
For the teams that are new in any season, give them a neutral starting score. 

The model will be using the dataset that I build with the scores to then predict goals.

The thing i need to figure out now is how to make those scores...

Attack score = Goals scored by team i per match / League average score per team per match.   (higher is better)
Defense score = Goals conceded by team i per match / League average score per team per match.   (lower is better)


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)

matches <- X14_15 %>%
  mutate(
    Date = dmy(as.character(Date)),
    Year = "2014/15",
    match_id = row_number()
  ) %>%
  arrange(Date, match_id)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)

# Combine home and away performances from 2013/14
previous_season_matches <- bind_rows(
  # Home team perspective
  X13_14 %>%
    transmute(
      Team = HomeTeam,
      goals_for = FTHG,
      goals_against = FTAG,
      result = case_when(
        FTR == "H" ~ "W",
        FTR == "A" ~ "L",
        FTR == "D" ~ "D"
      )
    ),

  # Away team perspective
  X13_14 %>%
    transmute(
      Team = AwayTeam,
      goals_for = FTAG,
      goals_against = FTHG,
      result = case_when(
        FTR == "A" ~ "W",
        FTR == "H" ~ "L",
        FTR == "D" ~ "D"
      )
    )
)

# Summarise the 2013/14 season for each team
previous_season_stats <- previous_season_matches %>%
  group_by(Team) %>%
  summarise(
    previous_season_goals_scored_per_match =
      mean(goals_for),

    previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match =
      mean(goals_against),

    previous_season_wins = sum(result == "W"),
    previous_season_draws = sum(result == "D"),
    previous_season_losses = sum(result == "L"),

    previous_season_points =
      sum(if_else(
        result == "W", 3,
        if_else(result == "D", 1, 0)
      )),

    previous_season_goal_difference =
      sum(goals_for - goals_against),

    previous_season_goals_scored = sum(goals_for),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(previous_season_points),
    desc(previous_season_goal_difference),
    desc(previous_season_goals_scored)
  ) %>%
  mutate(previous_season_ranking = row_number())
```

```{r}
median_previous_goals_scored <- median(
  previous_season_stats$previous_season_goals_scored_per_match,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

median_previous_goals_conceded <- median(
  previous_season_stats$previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
home_data <- matches %>%
  transmute(
    match_id, Date, Year,
    Team = HomeTeam,
    Opponent = AwayTeam,
    HomeAway = "Home",
    goals_for = FTHG,
    goals_against = FTAG,
    result = case_when(
      FTR == "H" ~ "W",
      FTR == "A" ~ "L",
      FTR == "D" ~ "D"
    ),
    red_cards = HR,
    yellow_cards = HY, 
    fouls = HF,
    corners = HC,
    shots = HS,
    shots_on_target = HST
  )

away_data <- matches %>%
  transmute(
    match_id, Date, Year,
    Team = AwayTeam,
    Opponent = HomeTeam, 
    HomeAway = "Away",
    goals_for = FTAG,
    goals_against = FTHG,
    result = case_when(
      FTR == "A" ~ "W",
      FTR == "H" ~ "L",
      FTR == "D" ~ "D"
    ),
    red_cards = AR,
    yellow_cards = AY,
    fouls = AF,
    corners = AC,
    shots = AS,
    shots_on_target = AST
  )

team_matches <- bind_rows(home_data, away_data) %>%
  arrange(Date, match_id, HomeAway)
```

```{r}
team_features <- team_matches %>%
  group_by(Team) %>%
  arrange(Date, match_id, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    # Number of matches played before this match
    matches_played = row_number() - 1L,
    
    previous_match_date = lag(Date),
    days_since_last_match = as.numeric(
      Date - previous_match_date
    ),
    # Previous results only
    wins = lag(cumsum(result == "W"), default = 0L),
    draws = lag(cumsum(result == "D"), default = 0L),
    losses = lag(cumsum(result == "L"), default = 0L),

    # Goals from previous matches only
    goals_scored_total = lag(cumsum(goals_for), default = 0),
    goals_conceded_total = lag(cumsum(goals_against), default = 0),

    # Cards from previous matches only
    red_cards_total = lag(cumsum(red_cards), default = 0),
    yellow_cards_total = lag(cumsum(yellow_cards), default = 0), 

    fouls_total =
      lag(cumsum(fouls), default = 0),

    corners_total =
      lag(cumsum(corners), default = 0),

    shots_total =
      lag(cumsum(shots), default = 0),

    shots_on_target_total =
      lag(cumsum(shots_on_target), default = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    win_frequency = wins / pmax(matches_played, 1),
    draw_frequency = draws / pmax(matches_played, 1),
    loss_frequency = losses / pmax(matches_played, 1),

    goals_scored_per_match = if_else(
      matches_played > 0,
      goals_scored_total / matches_played,
      NA_real_
    ),

    goals_conceded_per_match = if_else(
      matches_played > 0,
      goals_conceded_total / matches_played,
      NA_real_
    ),

    red_cards_per_match = if_else(
      matches_played > 0,
      red_cards_total / matches_played,
      NA_real_
    ),

    yellow_cards_per_match = if_else(
      matches_played > 0,
      yellow_cards_total / matches_played,
      NA_real_
    ),

    fouls_per_match = if_else(
      matches_played > 0,
      fouls_total / matches_played,
      NA_real_
    ),

    corners_per_match = if_else(
      matches_played > 0,
      corners_total / matches_played,
      NA_real_
    ),

    shots_per_match = if_else(
      matches_played > 0,
      shots_total / matches_played,
      NA_real_
    ),

    shots_on_target_per_match = if_else(
      matches_played > 0,
      shots_on_target_total / matches_played,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
team_features <- team_features %>%
  left_join(
    previous_season_stats %>%
      select(
        Team,
        previous_season_goals_scored_per_match,
        previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match,
        previous_season_wins,
        previous_season_draws,
        previous_season_losses,
        previous_season_ranking
      ),
    by = "Team"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    previous_season_goals_scored_per_match = coalesce(
      previous_season_goals_scored_per_match,
      median_previous_goals_scored
    ),

    previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match = coalesce(
      previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match,
      median_previous_goals_conceded
    ),

    # Weighted attacking strength
    attack_score = if_else(
      matches_played == 0,
      previous_season_goals_scored_per_match,
      (
        2 * previous_season_goals_scored_per_match +
          matches_played * goals_scored_per_match
      ) / (2 + matches_played)
    ),

    # Weighted defensive strength:
    # lower goals conceded means stronger defence
    defence_score = if_else(
      matches_played == 0,
      previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match,
      (
        2 * previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match +
          matches_played * goals_conceded_per_match
      ) / (2 + matches_played)
    )
  )
```


```{r}
opponent_features <- team_features %>%
  select(
    match_id,
    Team,
    matches_played,
    days_since_last_match,

    previous_season_goals_scored_per_match,
    previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match,
    previous_season_ranking,
    previous_season_wins,
    previous_season_draws,
    previous_season_losses,

    win_frequency,
    loss_frequency,
    draw_frequency,
    goals_scored_per_match,
    goals_conceded_per_match,

    attack_score,
    defence_score,

    red_cards_per_match,
    yellow_cards_per_match,
    fouls_per_match,
    corners_per_match,
    shots_on_target_per_match,
    shots_per_match
  ) %>%
  rename_with(
    ~ paste0("opp_", .x),
    -c(match_id, Team)
  ) %>%
  rename(Opponent = Team)
```

```{r}
dataset_2014 <- team_features %>%
  left_join(
    opponent_features,
    by = c("match_id", "Opponent")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Historical differences
    PDSF = previous_season_goals_scored_per_match -
      opp_previous_season_goals_scored_per_match,

    PDSCF = previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match -
      opp_previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match,

    PDR = previous_season_ranking -
      opp_previous_season_ranking,

    PDW = previous_season_wins -
      opp_previous_season_wins,

    PDD = previous_season_draws -
      opp_previous_season_draws,

    PDL = previous_season_losses -
      opp_previous_season_losses,

    # Round is represented by the difference in matches
    # already played by the two teams
    Round = matches_played - opp_matches_played,

    # Difference in days since the previous match
    Days = days_since_last_match -
      opp_days_since_last_match,

    # Current-season form differences
    DWF = win_frequency - opp_win_frequency,
    DLF = loss_frequency - opp_loss_frequency,
    DDF = draw_frequency - opp_draw_frequency,

    DGSF = goals_scored_per_match -
      opp_goals_scored_per_match,

    DGCF = goals_conceded_per_match -
      opp_goals_conceded_per_match,

    # Weighted strength differences
    DAS = attack_score - opp_attack_score,
    DDS = defence_score - opp_defence_score,

    # Additional features retained for feature selection
    DRF = red_cards_per_match -
      opp_red_cards_per_match,

    DYF = yellow_cards_per_match -
      opp_yellow_cards_per_match,

    DFF = fouls_per_match -
      opp_fouls_per_match,

    DCS = corners_per_match -
      opp_corners_per_match,

    DSTF = shots_on_target_per_match -
      opp_shots_on_target_per_match,

    DSF = shots_per_match -
      opp_shots_per_match
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    match_id,
    Year,
    Date,
    Team,
    Opponent,
    HomeAway,

    PDSF,
    PDSCF,
    PDR,
    PDW,
    PDD,
    PDL,

    Round,
    Days,

    DWF,
    DLF,
    DDF,
    DGSF,
    DGCF,

    DAS,
    DDS,

    DRF,
    DYF,
    DFF,
    DCS,
    DSTF,
    DSF,

    # Target: actual goals scored by the team of interest
    Goals = goals_for
  ) %>%
  arrange(match_id, desc(HomeAway == "Home"))
```
